info.name: GroupBookingLA API
info.description:
REST API of the GroupBookingLA backend.

How to use:
1. Start the backend (profile `dev` or `h2`) and pick the "GroupBookingLA - Local" environment.
2. Run "Auth / Login as Super Admin" first. Postman keeps the session cookie, so later requests are signed in.
3. Requests save ids for the next ones (quoteNumber, bookingRef, itemId, companyId, ...), so run a folder top to bottom.

Errors come back as JSON: {"error": "message"} with 400 (bad input), 401 (not signed in / not allowed), 404 (not found) or 409 (conflict).

item.name: Auth
item.description: Sign in and sign out. Run "Login as Super Admin" first.

request.description: Signs in and stores the session cookie. `remember: "true"` keeps the session for 30 days.

item.name: Registration (new company)
item.description: Run top to bottom: register, verify the OTP, then approve as Super Admin.

request.description: Quick registration. Returns the OTP in test/dev (RUZINN_OTP_ECHO=true); in production it is only emailed.
Signs the new user in. The company stays pending until a Super Admin approves it. Note: this replaces the current session - log in as Super Admin again afterwards.
Verify OTP signed in the new user; switch back to the Super Admin before approving.
The company becomes ACTIVE and its users can book.
Full registration: all profile fields are required. Choose the three files in Postman before sending.

item.name: Parks - Catalog and Quotes
item.description: Everything needed to build and price an itinerary.

request.description: Countries, parks, hotels and prices. Use the item ids in quotes.
AED is the base currency.
Companies and users a parent company can book for.
Prices the itinerary and saves it. Add "quoteNumber" to update an existing quote. "currency" can be AED, USD or INR.
Returns the PDF. In Postman use "Send and Download".
Validates passengers and card, takes the (mock) payment and records the booking. Parks that need passenger details require items[].passengers.
Charges the company credit (see "Company Bookings / Company credit").
Add-on parks list their required fields in quote.items[].passengerFields; send them in passengers[].extra.

item.name: Company Quotes
item.description: Saved quotes of the signed-in company.

request.description: Set "ACCEPTED" to turn the quote into a booking (response contains bookingRefNum).

item.name: Company Bookings
item.description: Child companies can view; parent-company users can also change bookings.

request.description: Parent companies may add ?companyId=... to filter.
Upload the ticket first; voucher/visa after that.
Use "preferred" as kind for the best available document.

item.name: Users
item.description: Company admins manage their users; the Super Admin manages all users.

request.description: role: COMPANY_USER or COMPANY_ADMIN. The Super Admin may add "companyId".
kind: vat or licence.

item.name: Admin - Items
item.description: Super Admin: parks, hotels and other bookable items.

request.description: datedType: DA (any date) or DT (time slots). bookingInfo: DFT (lead contact) or ADD_ON (passenger fields from extraFields).
